name: Office Assault
author: OutofStorageGames
description:
*UDPATE* Fixed the game over bugs.                                                                A seemingly mundane office has found itself under attack from terrorists. its up to you, Captain Joe Generic, to stop them and save the world!

Five levels of heroic action with 3 different weapons! A quick firing SMG, A powerful Shotgun, and a high capacity Assault Rifle are ready to be used against grunts, bruisers, heavies, and the Big Bad itself!
